channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Amazon EC2 C9g and C9gd instances are now available in Asia Pacific (Tokyo) region
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C9g and C9gd instances, powered by AWS Graviton5 processors, are available in the Asia Pacific (Tokyo) region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 M9g and M9gd instances are now available in four additional regions
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) M9g and M9gd instances, powered by AWS Graviton5 processors, are available in Europe (Ireland) and Asia Pacific (Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo) regions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 C8g instances now available in additional regions
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C8g instances are available in AWS Asia Pacific (Taipei, New Zealand), and AWS GovCloud (US-East) regions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Applications adds support for NVIDIA Blackwell GPU instances
item.description: Amazon WorkSpaces Applications now supports Graphics G7 instances, powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs and Intel Xeon Scalable (6th Gen) processors. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon SageMaker AI Batch Transform now supports G6e instances
item.description: Amazon SageMaker AI now supports Amazon EC2 G6e instances for batch transform. Batch Transform enables you to run predictions on datasets stored in Amazon S3 and is suited for large datasets that do not require a persistent inference… (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Transfer Family SFTP Connectors now support continuing file transfers during credential rotation
item.description: AWS Transfer Family SFTP Connectors now continue running file transfers while you rotate the credentials used to authenticate with remote SFTP servers. (1 source: aws)
